business.name: Pawfect Grooming
business.rating_source: yelp.com official page (2026-08-28); syndication rounds to 5.0 — official wins

source: serpapi yelp_reviews (full texts, real ratings, incl. hidden)

reviews.author: Debbie P.
reviews.text:
Mira did a fabulous job with Miss M!  She gave a great Cavalier cut for the summer and kept the signature feathering Cavaliers are known for.  

I like that she only takes one client at a time and has consistent, quick communication.  

I'd happily recommend her to anyone looking for a great groomer in the area!!!

reviews.author: Joenghee S.
reviews.text: Ellie has been coming to this grooming salon since she was a puppy. The groomer always takes such wonderful care of her, which is why we continue to come here even though it's a bit of a drive. We truly appreciate the care and attention they give her every visit Highly recommend

reviews.author: Rick A.
reviews.text: Mira is a true artist and a wonderful person. Mira loves dogs like they are her own. Expect the end result to be as discussed with Mira and  and a  beautiful result. You won't want to ever use anyone else !

reviews.author: Christina J.
reviews.text:
My dog hates grooming and is always scared when I drop him off.  
Pawfect Grooming is the exception. 
Mira is so gentle and loving with him.  I love the one to one care and the fact he never has to go in a crate.

reviews.author: Zilai F.
reviews.text: We've been going to Pawfect Grooming for over a year now, and Mira has been amazing every time. She's friendly, professional, fast, and always punctual, which I really appreciate. Nellie always comes back looking great, and Mira even dresses her up after the bath  it's so cute every time. You can tell she genuinely cares about the dogs she works with. We really love her service and will definitely keep coming back!

reviews.author: Hannah B.
reviews.text: Our big goldendoodle comes out quickly, looking great, and as happy as one can be after being groomed! We've booked 2 times and will come again.

reviews.author: Eddie A.
reviews.text: We're new to the area and couldn't be happier that we found such a well-qualified and attentive groomer for our French bulldog puppy! Mira provides a very welcoming environment that is perfectly suited for pets. She is patient and kind and we're delighted with the trust she has established with our puppy.

reviews.author: Mia Z.
reviews.text: The groomer is very skilled and i think my dog liked her. It was in a private residence so i was surprised about that. But yes i would go back

reviews.author: Laura B.
reviews.text: Took my two small dogs to Mira this morning for their first nail trim with her, and wow. One of my pups hates nail trims with a deep, dark passion. She goes from sweet cuddly lap dog to full Tasmanian devil the second you come near her with clippers or a grinder. Mira was so kind and patient with her. She cooed to her, rocked her, hugged her, and got those nails clipped without a muzzle, which has never happened before. If I could give her 100 stars instead of five, I would. We are not going anywhere else.

reviews.author: Monica S.
reviews.text:
I REALLY hesitate leaving review for her because I think she's the best groomer in the whole Seattle area and am so scared that she'd get booked out!

But she has been amazing with my two girls (shepherd and husky)! My girls were treated like queens while they were grooming and I came to find them chewing on some fancy snack from Mudbay. 

Not only does she use high quality products but she makes sure that the dogs are in private open area and not in crates after their washes. My girls smell soooo nice for at least two weeks despite them going to the park everyday. I've used so many different services for dog grooming and they have all been pretty mediocre until Pawfect Grooming! This place is def worth every cent!!!

reviews.author: Kristin F.
reviews.text: Mira's Pawfect Grooming is a treasure of a find! This is a 5-star (plus!) business. Mira is a kind, gentle and talented grooming professional. We had such a delightful experience. She is the perfect fit for our Finn and for us. She makes sure the dog is always comfortable while she works. From the initial contact, through confirming the appointment, the day-of reminder and the directions to her home - all went quite smoothly. But perhaps the best part was the actual grooming experience! Mira's gentleness put Finn immediately at ease. Her grooming space is calm and inviting. She gave Finn time in her studio to relax and get familiar while we talked through what type of cut would be best. Her guidance was perfect. Her prices on point. We will definitely be bringing him back for all of our future grooming needs from touch ups to complete "spa" visits. Like I said - she is a treasure.

reviews.author: Katie F.
reviews.text: My boy was super matted and hadn't had a haircut in awhile. Mira did a great job with him. Will definitely be going back for regular grooming.

reviews.author: Ray Z.
reviews.text: Mira did an incredible job on Charlie! She followed instructions perfectly and he is one happy boy! Her communication is great and very much appreciated. Glad to have found a new groomer in the area for him!

reviews.author: Trevor S.
reviews.text: First time coming here. I tried to get my dog Zoey groomed at Petco but they said she was too anxious and denied service to my old dog right before going out of town. I called Mira at Pawfect Grooming asking if there was any availability for her today and if she would be able to handle my "anxious dog". She set me up an appointment immediately that day! Mira did an absolutely amazing job on my old girl. Handling her with so much love, treats, and care! Mira asked me to stay with the dog to help calm her for the first visit so I got to see her work first hand. I couldn't recommend a better groomer from what I saw! Thanks again!

reviews.author: Guy S.
reviews.text: Pawfect grooming has been great for our puppy. Mira has a wonderful way of working with our rather mischievous girl. We're experimenting with different lengths and cuts. Mira also responds quickly to texts and questions. We'll keep coming back!

reviews.author: Chloe B.
reviews.text: Mira is the BEST! She is so kind and gentle with my mini Schnauzer and his cut always turns out perfect! I love her space, it's safe and secure and my puppy is comfortable. He doesn't always do well around other dogs so being groomed one on one makes his experience much more pleasant. He also loves that Mira does playtime while waiting for us to pick him up! Do not hesitate to bring your furry companion here, they're in safe and caring hands

reviews.author: Avery E.
reviews.text:
Mira is a fantastic groomer! She's so kind and great with animals. I loved my dog's haircut! I could tell Mira spent a lot of time and care and gave me exactly what I'd asked for.

It's so nice that she works from a studio from her home. I've gone to other places where you have to leave your dog for hours and pick them up in the evening, so your dog is in a cage all day waiting. That can be really stressful for animals. I love that at Pawfect Grooming, Mira is working on just your dog. She so gentle and patient and creates such a welcoming environment for the dog.

With a senior dog, I've gone to a lot of groomers in the area, and I highly recommend Mira! She is EXCELLENT. I'm so happy to have found her!

reviews.author: Narissa T.
reviews.text:
We have two senior Pomeranians with thick double coats that need regular deshedding and grooming. We want them to be stress free getting groomed so we switched over to Pawfect Grooming. Mira works in a calm space, and the whole process feels fun for the dogs. They jump around excited to see her and we have to convince them nicely to come home with us! They come home clean, soft, and comfortable instead of exhausted. 

I really appreciate how carefully she handles their coats and how clean she gets the area around their eyes. We don't go in asking for fancy cut since our priority is comfort and they just get clean.  Mira absolutely delivers on that. After the summer we'll let their hair grow back out and continue seeing Mira during that process!

 With Mira, I appreciate that she took a look at my girls coats while I was there so she could point out the fact that they needed a deshed, and she was very clear on the price and how much time it would take. With double coated pups like mine its nice to have transparency up front.

Lastly, Mira is also great to work with. She sends reminder texts before appointments and lets us know about 30 minutes before the dogs are finished, which gives us time to grab breakfast or run errands while they're being groomed.

reviews.author: Sheila V.
reviews.text:
We had our first grooming with Mira today. The appointment process went well and in fact, Mira was accommodating when I had to move our appointment time to 30 mins later. 

Mira has a great set up at home and this shows me how professional she is with her services. Since it was our first groom with her, she did take time to discuss the expectations of the grooming with me. 

Teddy has been on a regular schedule with our fav groomer over at Young's Pet Style but too bad they are permanently closed. I was on the lookout for another groomer when I came across Pawfect. We will be going back Mira at Pawfect again for Teddy!

reviews.author: Sid S.
reviews.text:
Took our pet here for their very first grooming appointment and had such a great experience! Owner was super friendly, professional, and made us (and our pet) feel completely at ease from the start.

S really took the time to listen to what we were looking for and handled everything with so much care. Our pet came out looking clean, happy, and well-groomed--exactly what we hoped for!

We're so glad we found this place and will definitely be coming back. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a groomer who truly cares!

reviews.author: Hannah S.
reviews.text:
I took both of my pups in for a last-minute full-service groom, and Mira was nothing short of incredible. Not only was she able to accommodate us on short notice, but she also created the calmest, most soothing environment for my dogs--something that's so rare and appreciated.

Mira is incredibly gentle, patient, and clearly loves what she does. She listened carefully to what I wanted, and somehow managed to make my vision a reality perfectly. Both of my dogs looked absolutely adorable and seemed genuinely relaxed and happy when I picked them up.

I highly recommend Mira to anyone looking for a groomer who truly cares. We're already looking forward to our next appointment!

reviews.author: Mary T.
reviews.text:
Outstanding service, my Milo had a great pampering time with Mira. she's very communicative and caring. 
Definitely we'll be back, 
 Well done Mira

reviews.author: Nallely L.
reviews.text: Took my little 10 lbs boy for a full service, she took about an hour and a half. She did such a great job with the haircut but also the ears and his nails. When I dropped him off he was shy but when I picked him up he was so happy. I will definitely be coming back.

reviews.author: J D.
reviews.text: Fantastic overall experience. Took great care of our Goldendoodle, Niko. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Deloria G.
reviews.text:
I took Nala to Pawfect grooming today. it is first time I took her to Mira.  My groomer has moved without notice   I was 100% pleased with her service.  Her place is clean and welcoming. She is very friendly and loving to my pet. 
my Australian labradoodle is 11 months and 29 days today.  Tomorrow 1 year old and head to East Coast. 

She got a treat. she has a lot anxiety and Mira was able to calm her and work with her.  Thank you for you professionalism and compassion for pets.    I made my return appointment, because I am well pleased.  I have a new groomer.    
it is hard when you have a doodle.  

Thank you
Sandi

reviews.author: Miyun K.
reviews.text: I'm a longtime friend of the owner, Mira. From what I know, she's incredibly skilled with her hands and truly loves and treasures dogs. She uses only gentle, high-quality products for bathing and puts great care into grooming. Please come and visit--your pets will be in the best hands!

reviews.author: Elizabeth P.
reviews.text: It was my dog's first time getting groomed here and she did super well! My dog looks very cute afterwards. Thank you!

reviews.author: Shantel D.
reviews.text: So happy I found this groomer!! Super comfortable and my dog is super happy. Great experience and will be back!

reviews.author: Soo Yeon P.
reviews.text: We had a great experience with her. She did an excellent job! Very professional and gentle. Our dog looked clean, well-trimmed, and happy afterwards. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Jinmi K.
reviews.text:
Highly recommend this grooming service for anyone looking in the Bellevue area!-Especially for a first grooming experience!

She has such a gentle touch and a warm heart. Each pup is treated with so much love and care, as if they were her own. The space is calm, clean, and welcoming--perfect for both pets and their humans. 

You can feel that she loves what she does and puts her heart into every appointment.

If you're looking for someone you can completely trust with your furry friend, this is the place. Thank U
